title: To Kill an Empire
description: The Dark Brotherhood's final contract: assassinate the Emperor. Using the Gourmet's Writ of Passage, infiltrate Castle Dour, poison the Emperor's meal, and escape. But the mission ends in betrayal â€” the Emperor was a decoy, and Commander Maro has sent forces to destroy the Sanctuary.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
I have assigned the player to assassinate the Emperor.
I provided the Jarrin Root poison for the assassination.

REPORT_TO_ASTRID: I have given the player final instructions for the Emperor's assassination.
The player must use the Gourmet's Writ of Passage to infiltrate Castle Dour.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary is under attack by Penitus Oculatus forces sent by Commander Maro.
Someone within the Brotherhood betrayed the organization and revealed the assassination plan to Commander Maro.
The Emperor assassination was a trap — the target was only a decoy, not Titus Mede II.
Astrid must now face the catastrophic consequences of the failed contract and the assault on her Family.

base_facts: I am the commander of the Penitus Oculatus, the Emperor's security force.
My son Gaius Maro was killed by the Dark Brotherhood.

INFILTRATE_CASTLE: I allowed the Gourmet into Castle Dour after verifying the writ of passage.
ESCAPE_AND_BETRAYAL: I revealed the Emperor was a decoy and that someone in the Dark Brotherhood betrayed the player.
I broke my deal and sent agents to destroy the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
QUEST_COMPLETE: He revealed the Emperor was a decoy and that someone in the Dark Brotherhood betrayed the player's plans to him.
He broke his deal with the traitor and sent Penitus Oculatus agents to destroy the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
He has taken his revenge for his son Gaius Maro's death by ordering the attack on the Sanctuary.
The player has been marked with a bounty in Haafingar for the Emperor's murder.

base_facts: I am the head chef at Castle Dour.
I am honored to work alongside the famous Gourmet.

COOK_THE_MEAL: The Gourmet and I prepared the Potage le Magnifique for the Emperor.
The Gourmet added a secret ingredient to the stew.
QUEST_COMPLETE: She served the Potage le Magnifique to the Emperor's decoy, unaware it was poisoned.
She witnessed the Emperor's death in the Castle Dour dining room.
She attempted to defend the player when the Penitus Oculatus guards attacked after the assassination.

beats.comment: Astrid briefs the player on the Emperor assassination plan and provides the Jarrin Root.
Player reports to Commander Maro and enters Castle Dour with the Writ of Passage.
Player meets Gianna, dons chef's hat, and prepares the Potage le Magnifique with the Jarrin Root poison.
Player follows Gianna to the dining room and kills the Emperor's decoy.
Player escapes the tower, is ambushed by Maro who reveals the decoy and the Dark Brotherhood betrayal, then must return to the Sanctuary.
Player returns to the Sanctuary as the Dark Brotherhood is under attack. Quest ends.
